question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id
  FROM olist_orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_unique_orders AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    do2.order_id,
    c.customer_city,
    c.customer_state
  FROM delivered_orders do2
  JOIN olist_customers c ON do2.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
customer_agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_order_count,
    customer_city,
    customer_state
  FROM customer_unique_orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id, customer_city, customer_state
  ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC, customer_unique_id
  LIMIT 3
),
customer_payments AS (
  SELECT
    cu.customer_unique_id,
    AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value
  FROM customer_unique_orders cu
  JOIN olist_order_payments op ON cu.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY cu.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  ca.customer_unique_id,
  ca.delivered_order_count,
  ROUND(cp.avg_payment_value, 2) AS avg_payment_value,
  ca.customer_city,
  ca.customer_state
FROM customer_agg ca
JOIN customer_payments cp ON ca.customer_unique_id = cp.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY ca.delivered_order_count DESC;
